public.expected_payments.definition: SELECT j.user_id, 'job'::text AS source_type, j.id AS source_id, j.est_pay_date AS expected_date, j.client_name AS label, j.job_number AS reference_number, COALESCE(( SELECT sum(COALESCE(te.st_hours, te.total_hours, 0::numeric) * COALESCE(j.pay_rate, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(te.ot_hours, 0::numeric) * COALESCE(j.ot_rate, j.pay_rate * 1.5, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(te.dt_hours, 0::numeric) * COALESCE(j.dt_rate, j.pay_rate * 2::numeric, 0::numeric)) AS sum FROM job_time_entries te WHERE te.job_id = j.id), CASE WHEN j.rate_type = 'daily'::text AND j.start_date IS NOT NULL AND j.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN j.pay_rate * (j.end_date - j.start_date + 1)::numeric WHEN j.rate_type = 'flat'::text THEN j.pay_rate ELSE 0::numeric END) AS expected_amount, j.status, j.start_date, j.end_date, j.brand_id, j.created_at FROM contractor_jobs j WHERE j.est_pay_date IS NOT NULL AND (j.status = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'invoiced'::text])) UNION ALL SELECT i.user_id, 'invoice'::text AS source_type, i.id AS source_id, i.due_date AS expected_date, i.contact_name AS label, i.invoice_number AS reference_number, i.total - i.amount_paid AS expected_amount, i.status, i.invoice_date AS start_date, NULL::date AS end_date, i.brand_id, i.created_at FROM invoices i WHERE i.direction = 'receivable'::text AND i.due_date IS NOT NULL AND (i.status = ANY (ARRAY['sent'::text, 'overdue'::text]))
public.expected_payments.name: expected_payments
